scientific_integrity: Universal finite-word theorem established by elementary gap equations; exhaustive literal-word checks at n<=8 support, but do not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: Sharp only for a pair of binary words of Hamming weight two, with identical zero-only gap insertions; does not assert an all-weight bound, unrestricted-alphabet insertion optimum, or multiword extension. Historic-priority risk from unindexed earlier calculations and incomplete examination of a 2025 foundational full text.
title: Sharp zero-only cyclic equalization cost for binary words of Hamming weight two
